decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is the core of the firm's publicly announced move toward binding mobile communication and carries years of R&D investment, so management will keep it.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is the communicated backbone of the integrated offer, so withdrawing it would undercut the firm's positioning.
The email-to-app delivery robot extends the committed secure channel, and its modest uptake can still be attributed to slow customer digitization, so the firm persists with it.
Despite the shift toward app-based authentication, the sunk hardware investment and remaining regulated customers justify keeping the QR token for now, though withdrawal risk is rising.
The payment compliance suite supports the regulatory positioning the firm has publicly built on, and weak results can be blamed on long compliance adoption cycles.
